mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near Badger Ridge Middle School. We are looking at an overnight low of 37 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona has announced asphalt repair work for November 10 and 11. Crews will be milling and patching areas near Nine Mound Road, Morningside Boulevard, and Mozart Street, so expect no-parking signs between 7 AM and 7 PM.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market today. You can also catch live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's, while tomorrow offers more live music over at the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Looking at the weekly report, on October 25, officers responded to a situation where a driver was found in their vehicle at an intersection and subsequently arrested for an O W I offence.
The Really Reese's flavor is the highlight today, but since we are within the final half-hour of business, you will want to head over to the shop right away before they close for the night.
